Числа треугольников и плотности текселей — предложенный ориентир H2 (герой 30–45k tris, атлас 4K мастер + 2K рантайм, ≤ 2 слота), не бюджет (GD-058 открыт). Художественной приёмки нет. H2.1 (2026-09-29): маска металла и PBR-значения (textures.materials), чистка остатков плаща (phantom_repaint.cloth_cleanup), кадры до/после (review_h21).

phantom_note: Измерено стадией inspect (кадры preview/inspect/, отчёт reports/inspect-sources.json): боковой концепт — ЛЕВЫЙ вид (prompts.md: нарисован поверх ortho_left, фигура смотрит влево), а подан в слот RIGHT. Tripo понял его зеркально (перед фигуры — сзади, ближняя левая рука — правая) и достроил фантомные дубли: второй меч с кулаком и навершием за спиной (11, 13, 18), вторую опущенную правую руку (наруч 14 + латная перчатка 19), наколенник с драконом на задней стороне правого бедра (16), львиный медальон на задней стороне правого плеча (20), второй профиль лица на правой стороне головы (часть 6). Фантомы удаляются, голова симметризуется по чистой левой половине. Это геометрические правки, не художественная приёмка; настоящий ремонт — повторная генерация Tripo со слотом LEFT (платно, не выполнялось).

lowpoly.method_note: per part: Blender Decimate COLLAPSE (quadric, triangulated, no symmetry) on the welded untextured high-poly to target_tris; cleanup: weld 1e-6 m, dissolve degenerate, delete loose, triangulate; smooth shading, hard edges only on UV seams with a dihedral angle above uv.sharp_angle_deg

grip_bridge.name: LP_grip_bridge
grip_bridge.why: Tripo modelled no grip inside the fist: the blade/guard part and the grip/pommel part leave a gap hidden by the fist; an open cylinder makes the separate weapon whole (same repair as the 2026-09-28 candidate)

lowpoly.min_triangle_area_note: UE drops triangles below 1e-4 cm2 (candidate_build.core.DEGENERATE_AREA_CM2); final = Tripo x 0.613 -> 1e-8 m2 final = 2.7e-8 m2 Tripo; x4 margin -> 1.1e-7 m2; the first build left 80 such slivers on the sword (readback check)

uv.method_note: charts per part (charts.py: normal-cone region growing over the face adjacency, folds > 120 deg always cut, small charts merged, SLIM MINIMUM_STRETCH unwrap with no_flip, islands that flip or compress below bad_area_ratio re-segmented with a narrower cone); every island scaled to a uniform texel density (sqrt(3D area / UV area)) times the part's texel_priority (bottom faces of the base: bottom_faces_priority), then one pack of all parts (rotate ANY, CONCAVE, margin fraction) into 0..1. Smart UV Project was measured first and rejected: 6019 islands, 4.8 % coverage
uv.pack_margin_note: Blender FRACTION margin is applied on each island side: measured gap = 39 px for 0.00488 at 4096 (first pack), so 0.0022 targets ~18 px; required island gap >= 16 px at 4K (8 px padding each side, >= 8 px gap at 2K); measured by stage uvcheck

bake.engine: Cycles (Blender 5.2.2), selected-to-active per low part from its own high part(s)
bake.cage_note: Tripo frame (figure 0.98 m incl. sword; x 0.613 -> final). Measured low<->high deviation (stage lowpoly): p95 0.2-0.9 mm, max 3.4 mm (cloak); the cage starts 4 mm outside the low surface and searches 10 mm inward, i.e. -6..+4 mm around the low surface; misses are counted by the HIT pass

team_mask.format: RGBA 8-bit linear: R = cloth (TeamColor on clothing, user decision U-3 / AD-CNF-58 = b), G = base band (side wall of the base), B = 0, A = 255. Wave 4 proposal: 1-channel TeamMask read as .R by M_UM_Figure (TC_Grayscale) - compatible; the base band G is an input for M_UM_BaseMarker only if wave 4 adopts it (it currently uses a vertex mask R / side-wall normal)
team_mask.cloth_parts_note: cloak, front tabard and the torso part (its red collar/cloak lining only, through the colour rule); pauldrons are excluded (their red texels are cloak bleed of the Tripo texture)
team_mask.rule_note: measured on the baked BC (4K, hit texels): cloak red hue 330-15 deg, s p10/p50/p90 0.70/0.75/0.79, v p5/p95 0.32/0.46; gold embroidery hue 20-55 deg stays out of the mask
team_mask.edge: soft edge = normalised Gaussian inside the cloth parts' coverage (gauss(cloth * cov) / gauss(cov)), then the gutters and the empty atlas take the nearest covered texel like BC; the first build blurred over the empty gutter and cut at the bake margin, so the edge row of the cloth islands fell to R 0.60 (interior 0.93) and a TeamDye render showed red hairlines on the cloak seams (review 2026-09-29)

phantom_repaint.method: texels of these parts whose Tripo-frame position (POS bake) lies within zone_m of a phantom vertex take BC and ORM from the nearest clean texel of the donor part at the mirrored point (x' = 2 * plane - x; the left back of the figure is clean), feathered over feather_m; the phantom miss clusters (miss_clusters) and the boxes are repainted too; the normal is blended to flat (the baked normal carries the phantom imprint or does not exist)
phantom_repaint.why: the Tripo texture painted the phantoms onto the garments they crossed (grey/gold streaks of the phantom back sword, the dragon knee plate and the lion medallion on the cloak back; review close_cloak_back of the first build)
phantom_repaint.donor_note: mirror lookup of the cloak in a metric with Y (depth toward the back) weighted 0.15: the back of the cloak is a height field over (x, z), and the smoothed strip lies up to 47 mm inward, so a plain 3D nearest donor projected far-off points onto folds (median 10.7 mm, 44 % distinct donors = smears); scaled: median 1.9 mm, 61-66 % distinct. Among the 8 nearest donors the first whose POS normal faces the mirrored target normal (dot >= 0.2) wins, so the inner and outer cloth layers are never swapped. mirror_cloth shifts the query along x in 3 mm steps (<= 24 mm) until the unrestricted donor is red cloth: the left border band lies about 2 cm more central than the right one (measured on the back renders), so without the shift the column next to the right band takes the band's edge texel (vertical streaks); the scaled metric applies only to targets facing along Y (|n_y| >= 0.5): fold walls facing sideways use the plain 3D metric (the scaled one collapsed them onto a few donors: vertical streaks on the fold at the right edge of the strip)

boxes.why: the cloak back carries a raised vertical strip with gold tabs (the phantom back sword/scabbard printed into the cloak geometry and texture) and the knee-plate hole, 2-4 cm from the phantom vertices, so outside zone_m; box measured on an orthographic back render of the high-poly cloak (x -0.091..-0.056, z 0.345..0.504) plus margin; mode plain: the median of clean cloak texels in a 3 cm shell around the box (a mirrored donor brought the opposite border band into the box, first repaint run)
boxes.mode_note: was 'plain' (median cloth colour: a smooth patch without the weave, visible in close_cloak_back); now the clean red-cloth texels of the mirrored left back, which carry the weave and the dragon panel edge
boxes.extent_note: extended 2026-09-29 (review): x -0.100 -> -0.108 covers the gold tab printed on the fold at the right edge of the strip (x -0.104, z 0.44-0.47); z 0.33 -> 0.27 covers the tail of the trail below the strip (gold/grey fragments at z 0.30-0.32); large gold components inside the box keep the Tripo paint (keep_band). Tried z 0.53 -> 0.565 for the small top tab (x -0.086, z 0.540-0.554): the raised top of the strip has no good mirror donor there and became a smeared flat patch larger than the tab, so the top stays at 0.53 and the tab is a listed residual

miss_clusters.why: texels without a ray hit have no high-poly surface under them: the filled phantom holes (68/106/39 edges on the cloak, 77 on the right forearm) and the smoothed strip. The first build filled them from the nearest hit texel anywhere in the atlas (4 906 texels took another part, 28 144 a texel > 17 px away): a grey steel patch on the right hip of the cloak (ortho_right) and gold/black fragments along the right edge of the plain box down to the hem. Now every 8-connected miss cluster of a repaint part that comes within max_phantom_dist_m of a phantom vertex is repainted with weight 1 (+ a feather_m ring); all other misses take the nearest hit texel of their own UV island
miss_clusters.mode_note: mirror_cloth for the cloak: the holes and the strip lie in plain red cloth in the concept (between the dragon panel and the right border band, and on the right hip); the mirror of the figure is not exact, so an unrestricted donor brings the other side's border band into them

residue_check.why: measured share of grey/dark and gold texels of the cloak in the phantom misses and within 4 cm of the phantoms, against the mirrored clean side

phantom_repaint.phantom_zone_modes_note: cloak phantom zone: 1 730 of its 56 034 hit texels are gold, 629 of them in large gold components (the right border band where it reaches the shoulder, z 0.70-0.75: Tripo painted it correctly up to the shoulder, only the medallion hole beside it is defective), 1 101 in small fragments (phantom paint). An unrestricted mirror stamped the left band about 2 cm off next to the right band (a broken double band at the shoulder, a knot fragment at the knee-plate zone). Now the hit texels of large gold components (dilated 2 px) keep the Tripo paint (weight 0) and all other zone texels take red-cloth donors
phantom_repaint.normal_transfer_note: the first builds blended the repainted normal to flat: the weave came back in BC but the repainted areas read smoother than the untouched cloth in close_cloak_back; now the donor's tangent normal is moved as detail relief (donor frame -> object space -> mirror -> minimal rotation onto the target normal -> target frame; frames from the POS gradients); normals that disagree (dot < 0.2) stay flat

materials.status: измерено (H2.1, 2026-09-29): маска металла и PBR-значения по классам; H2.2 (2026-09-29): сталь лат тёмная воронёная по концепту (замер яркости стальных зон, проверка ±15 %), клинок светлый как в H2.1; художественной приёмки нет
materials.why: Tripo metallicRoughness gave the armour almost no metal (H2: metallic mean 0.074 over the atlas, > 0.5 on 0.27 % of the texels): plate, crown, sword and the gold trims rendered as paint. Concept: steel plate and blade, gold trims/crown/hilt, red cloth with gold embroidery, leather belt
materials.method: materials.py: soft class weights from the painted BC (sRGB HSV ramps, no hard edges), per part group; metal texels get a PBR base colour (= specular reflectance F0: steel neutral grey, gold) keeping the painted luminance detail, metallic = metal weight; roughness steel / gold ranges with cavities rougher; non-metal keeps the painted colour, roughness = Tripo roughness clamped per class
materials.groups_note: armour: metal by default except red (collar lining, red gems) and the leather regions; cloth (cloak, tabard): non-metal except gold (embroidery, borders: gold thread read as gold metal); head: non-metal (skin, hair, beard) except strict gold inside the crown / neck-ring regions; stone: the base, never metal
materials.colour_rules_note: sRGB HSV of the painted BC; hue windows in degrees (330..15 wraps), smoothstep over hue_soft_deg outside; s_ramp / v_ramp = smoothstep from a to b; v_max_ramp = 1 - smoothstep. Measured H2 BC (4K): cloak red s p50 0.75, v 0.34-0.47; armour gold hue 24-32, s 0.45-0.53, v ~0.6; warm dark steel hue 0-30, s ~0.3, v ~0.28 (stays steel inside the metal: gold share only, metallic 1 either way); skin hue 19-21, s 0.28-0.36 (gold_strict excludes it: hue >= 23, s >= 0.42, v >= 0.40); crown gold hue 26-32, s 0.46-0.53, v 0.56-0.73
materials.leather_note: the belt band of the torso part (Tripo frame z 0.497-0.593, measured: brown texels 43-65 % there, hue ~21-26, s ~0.46, v ~0.3); the lion buckle and the studs are bright gold (v > 0.5) and stay metal
materials.head_regions_note: crown from Tripo z 0.840 (gold share 0.22 -> 0.86 over z 0.840-0.850; the forehead below is skin: a first rule with z 0.842 and the loose gold rule made a metallic strip on the forehead, fixed by gold_strict); neck ring below z 0.757 (gold 94-100 %)

metal.steel_h22_note: H2.2 rev. 2 (2026-09-29, after the review of rev. 1). H2.1 mapped the plate to a neutral grey F0 0.52 (polished chrome, white under the UE Cobble sky). Rev. 1 matched the ABSOLUTE mean luminance of the steel in studio_env to the concept (F0 median 0.055, gamma 0.5): studio_env lights the unchanged stone x2.1 brighter than the concept light, so the plate came out ~2x too dark next to the cloth and the stone (review: black lacquer; greaves and tassets near black, engraving lost, gauntlets as dark as the plates; Cobble steel/board 0.17-0.20). Rev. 2 calibrates against the concept RELATIVE to reference materials of the same frame (steelcheck.py, review_h22.steel_check.relative: (Y_steel / Y_ref)_render / (Y_steel / Y_ref)_concept, references = stone of the base and red cloth, geometric mean, pooled front/side/back) and checks the Cobble-light frame (steel / board 0.4-0.6). Candidates (C:/tmp/h22b, full textures stage + studio_env ortho + Cobble K2 each): F0 0.10 gamma 0.8 -> rel 0.85, Cobble 0.31/0.39; F0 0.12 -> rel 0.96, Cobble 0.36/0.45 but the steel read bronze (30 % painted chroma + warm tint); 0.12 + chroma_keep 0.1, tint (1.02, 1.0, 0.96), legs 0.16 -> rel 0.99, Cobble 0.39/0.47; + plate 0.13, pauldrons 0.10 -> rel 1.005, Cobble 0.404/0.473; accepted: + legs 0.20 -> rel 1.04, Cobble 0.43/0.49, greaves zone 0.37 (H2 0.27). Accepted values: plate core median -> 0.13 linear (the painted Tripo median 0.045), gamma 0.8 (the painted engraving contrast comes back; rev. 1 had 0.5), clamp 0.04-0.19, 10 % painted chroma + tint (1.02, 1.0, 0.96), roughness 0.45-0.55 (cavities rough, raised paint smooth). Per part (steel_part_overrides): legs tripo_part_2/3 (greaves, knees, sabatons) 0.20, clamp 0.06-0.26, roughness 0.50-0.55 - the vertical greaves reflect the dark lower half of studio.exr and stay the darkest zone (0.37 of the concept); pauldrons tripo_part_7/8 0.10 - lit from above they are the brightest zone (x2.0). Gauntlets: no override - their painted Tripo steel is 1.7x the plate median (0.075 vs 0.045), with gamma 0.8 they come out ~1.5x the plate BC and the gauntlet zone measures 1.04 of the concept (lighter than the plates, as in the concept). No curvature edge wear: the concept plate edges are gold trims. The blade (tripo_part_10, own reference) keeps the H2.1 values (light polished steel as in the concept). The BC medians 0.13 (plate) and 0.20 (legs) are above the 0.04-0.12 of the H2.2 task: at 0.10-0.12 the relative check and the Cobble check are not met (see the candidates)

materials.metal_note: steel: F0 of iron is ~0.56 linear. The median luminance of the steel core texels (metal >= 0.95, gold share <= 0.05; measured, reported as refs) maps to bc_target_linear 0.52; the blade has its own reference (painted 6.7x brighter than the plate). gamma 1 keeps the painted contrast (engraving, mail), clamp [0.06, 0.68], 10 % of the painted chromaticity kept. Tried first (Blender, studio.exr / courtyard.exr worlds): gamma 0.45 with target 0.56 washed the engraving out and read as chrome; targets 0.35-0.40 (darker than PBR steel) changed the look little under an environment (the reflection dominates) and leave the stated 0.5-0.65 range, so the median stays at 0.52. gold: chromaticity 50 % toward (1.0, 0.72, 0.32) (the Tripo gold is orange, hue 24-30), luminance target 0.45 for the median gold core texel, gamma 0.7. Roughness: detail = log(lum / ref) mapped over roughness_detail_ratio; texels darker than 0.45 x ref take the rough end, brighter than 2.2 x ref the smooth end
materials.non_metal_note: Tripo roughness clamped: cloth (and the red/non-metal texels of armour parts) 0.75-0.9, leather 0.75-0.9, head (skin/hair/beard) 0.55-0.8 (H2 had hair at 0.45-0.54: a glassy dome inside the crown), stone unchanged (only metallic -> 0)

cobble.source: unreal/Unmatched/Config/ArtBoards/S08ArtBoardProfiles.json lightProfiles.cobble-probe (read-only): directional key 4.5 lux, rotation pitch -55 yaw 30, no colour (white, 6500 K off; labelled 'cool scene key'); sky = TC_S08_AmbientDome x 11.2, colour (1, 1, 1); exposure histogram-fixed EV100 1.3; warm point 85 cd at (260, -300, 250) uu, radius 450
cobble.not_included: the warm point (85 cd, attenuation radius 450 uu) does not reach the figure cell: the P17 figure stands at (0, 50, 0) uu, 502 uu from the light; UE Lumen GI / reflections, TSR and the UE tonemapper are approximated by EEVEE ray tracing and the AgX view transform; the board is a flat plane with the mean albedo of the cobblestone texture (no stones, no normal map)
cobble.units_note: UE lux / cd/m2 and Blender sun strength / world strength use the same convention (a white Lambertian surface under a uniform world of radiance L renders L; under a sun of E renders E / pi), so the numbers go 1:1; exposure = 1 / (1.2 * 2^EV100) (the saturation-based EV100 convention of UE / Frostbite)
cobble.calibration: board albedo = mean linear colour of art/imagegen/mvp-v1/materials/export/T_cobblestone_D_2048.png (Y 0.120); exposure: log2(1 / (1.2 * 2^1.3)) alone put the board at display median 164 (sRGB 8-bit, K2 5x az 0), the UE Cobble editor frame of the H2.1 import (docs/art-pipeline/evidence/w5c-arthur-h2-ue-2026-09-29/arthur-h2-k2-5x-az0-blue-ue-editor.jpg, parallel UE import wave) has the board at luma p50 129.4; offsets -0.8 / -1.2 stops gave 136 / 121 -> -1.0 (measured 2026-09-29, C:/tmp/h22_arthur/r_exp*)

steel_check.light: studio_env (the H2.1 comparison light: three suns + studio.exr)
steel_check.metric: mean relative luminance Y (Rec.709) of the sRGB-decoded pixels of the steel masks, pooled over the three ortho views

gate.note: sRGB HSV of the pixel: saturation <= s_max (gold trims, red cloth, brown leather out), value >= v_min (black gaps out)

relative.note: H2.2 rev. 2 gate (2026-09-29): steel luminance relative to reference materials of the same frame (stone of the base, red cloth, gold; the steel pass does not change them), concept vs render: ratio_r = (Y_steel / Y_r)_render / (Y_steel / Y_r)_concept; gate = geometric mean over the references, pooled over front/side/back, within +-tolerance of 1. Why: H2.2 rev. 1 matched the ABSOLUTE mean Y in studio_env, which lights the unchanged stone x2.1 brighter than the concept's own light, so the steel came out ~2x too dark next to the other materials (review: 'black lacquer' instead of the concept's dark grey blued steel). Gold is not a reference: the material pass of H2.1 made it a metal (it reflects the environment like the steel and differs from the concept gold: concept hue 30 / saturation 0.51, render hue 40 / saturation 0.37), and it is not unchanged since H2

stone.note: the vertical face of the base (concept: rectangle inside the face; render: the stone class, eroded)

red_cloth.note: concept: every pixel passing the red gate (the cloak, the tabard, the collar lining); render: the red-cloth class x the same gate

steel_check.concept_zones_note: concept pixel coordinates (1190 x 1322 for front and side; the back concept is 1189 x 1323 and is used as is), drawn inside the armour silhouette on a 25 px grid: no background pixel inside a zone (a background model would cut dark steel that looks like the backdrop). Excluded by construction: blade, head, crown, base, cloak

exposure_reference.note: informative, not the gate: the stone of the base (unchanged since H2) in the concept front vs the model front in studio_env; concept / render = how much brighter studio_env lights a diffuse material than the concept's own light; steel ratio x that factor = the steel ratio with the exposure of the concept
